digest.component_or_area: S3 Coordinator for non-create plan execution and failure scoping
propositions: Non-create plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict handling) must execute atomic postconditions in dependency order, preserving successful earlier operations and re-observing only remaining drift after partial failure.

Failure dispositions must be normalized into scopes (ticket-local, endpoint, provider, tenant, global) such that ticket-local and permanent failures isolate to their ticket while broad-scoped failures stop only their declared scope.

Endpoint-failure fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across at least two tickets on that endpoint; provider fuse additionally requires outcomes spanning at least two distinct endpoints of the same provider; a matching success resets consecutive counter state.
Physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, opaque diagnostics (commit_unknown), and non-budget-capped transients must be excluded from fuse eligibility counters.

When a fuse opens, remaining matching plans defer with reason, scope, and retry_not_before metadata while independent scopes continue; exact tallies of applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered outcomes must be preserved.
